subject: Maths
title: Short division
subtitle: Multiplication and Division (Times Tables to 12×12) · KS3 Maths
learning_objective: I can use short division (bus-stop) to divide by a single-digit number.

key_vocab.definition: Short division is a quick written method for dividing by a SINGLE-digit number. We carry remainders mentally.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can use short division (bus-stop) to divide by a single-digit number.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: Short division -- Short division is a quick written method for dividing by a SINGLE-digit number. We carry remainders mentally.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Divide each digit left-to-right. If a digit is too small, carry to the next as a remainder.
936 ÷ 6 = 156
Left to right; carry small remainders

Key examples:
  ✓ 84 ÷ 4 = 21  (no remainder)
  ✓ 85 ÷ 4 = 21 r 1  (with remainder)
  ✓ 936 ÷ 6 = 156  (3-digit)
  ✗ Carry to the LEFT  (carry to the RIGHT)
  ✗ Skip a digit if too small  (write 0 above)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – no remainder
  Calculate 84 ÷ 4
  8 ÷ 4 = 2 (write above 8)
  4 ÷ 4 = 1 (write above 4)
  Read off: 21
  = 21
  (Check: 21 × 4 = 84 ✓)

Example 2 – with carry
  Calculate 75 ÷ 3
  7 ÷ 3 = 2 r 1 (carry the 1 to next digit → 15)
  15 ÷ 3 = 5
  Read off: 25
  = 25
  (The remainder ‘1’ from 7÷3 joins the next digit 5 to make 15.)

sections.title: With carry
sections.content:
Carry small remainders to the next digit.

(a) 75 ÷ 3
(b) 92 ÷ 4
(c) 68 ÷ 4
(d) 238 ÷ 7

sections.title: Writing zero in answer
sections.content:
If a digit doesn't divide, write 0 in the answer.

(a) 612 ÷ 6
(b) 509 ÷ 5
(c) 303 ÷ 3
(d) 808 ÷ 4

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ Carry remainders to the next digit on the RIGHT
✗ 612 ÷ 6 = 12 (skip the 1)
✓ 85 ÷ 4 = 21 r 1
✗ Short division works for any divisor
✓ Always check: quotient × divisor + remainder = dividend
